messages:
amir_fin: FYI CedarPoint Labs flagged a weird balance after their account merge 1: a $9,500 migration credit shows applied to the wrong child account. invoice/credits look off. can billing confirm?

tom_billing: pulling contract + ledger. which contract id?

amir_fin: main contract CED-2024-011, merge created parent account CED-HOLDINGS on 2028-06-01 and we consolidated two child accounts (CED-MAIN-001, CED-ALT-009). customer says credit should be on CED-MAIN-001.

billing-bot: Credit Memo CM-2028-0605-999 created for CED-MAIN-001 1 $9,500 (applied). PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2028-0605-999.pdf

nora_csm: background: Sales approved a one-time migration credit to offset the platform fee for CED-MAIN-001. Sales created credit on 2028-06-05 but the account merge flow remapped payments/credits to the first child account (CED-ALT-009) instead of preserving the original target. customer called upset that their primary app (CED-MAIN-001) still shows platform fee due.

li_sales: we intended the credit for CED-MAIN-001. CRM note: "apply migration credit to main account only". looks like the merge script used a "default child" rule.

tom_billing: ledger shows CM-2028-0605-999 posted and applied to CED-ALT-009, not CED-MAIN-001. we'll need to reverse the wrong application and reapply to the correct account. options: 1) issue reversal credit on CED-ALT-009 and then reissue CM on CED-MAIN-001 (preferred for audit trail) 2) move accounting allocation internally (more invasive). Any objections?

eric_fpna: prefer reversal + reissue for clear GL audit. note GL impact will net to zero but we need memo codes for month close. Also need to confirm whether AR payment was applied against the credit on the wrong account.

legal-bot: Reminder: cross-entity credits may require intercompany memo if billing entities differ. confirm billing entity for both child accounts.

amir_fin: both child accounts bill under Redwood Inference, same billing entity. not an intercompany issue.

sophie_finance: approval: $9,500 < $10k so finance auto-approve reversal+reissue. please include reason: "credit misapplied during account merge - reallocate to intended child account per sales note."

tom_billing: Roger. I'll create Reversal-CM-RV-2028-0616-200 to reverse CM-2028-0605-999 on CED-ALT-009 and then produce CM-2028-0616-201 targeting CED-MAIN-001. ETA 20m. I'll also check if customer payment used the credit; if so we'll reapply payments accordingly.

tom_billing: Invoice snippet from the wrong child (CED-ALT-009) PDF:

```
Invoice INV-2028-0610-420 for CED-ALT-009
1 x Private Deployment License (annual) 1 60,000.00
Platform Fee (annual) 1 12,000.00
Support - Premium (monthly) 1 4,200.00
Credit Memo CM-2028-0605-999 (migration credit) 1 -9,500.00
Total 1 66,700.00
Note: Credit originally intended for CED-MAIN-001
```

nbilling-bot: Draft Reversal Credit RV-2028-0616-200 created reversing CM-2028-0605-999 on CED-ALT-009. Draft Credit CM-2028-0616-201 created for CED-MAIN-001 1 $9,500. PDFs: https://invoices.internal/redwood/RV-2028-0616-200-draft.pdf , https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2028-0616-201-draft.pdf

eric_fpna: please add memo codes: "merge-credit-reverse" and "merge-credit-reapply". I'll handle journal JNL-2028-06-REV-ALLOC at month close. Confirm whether any cash was applied.

tom_billing: quick check: no customer payment consumed the credit; it reduced open AR on CED-ALT-009 only. no cash reapplication needed. Posting now.

billing-bot: Reversal RV-2028-0616-200 posted and applied to CED-ALT-009. Credit CM-2028-0616-201 posted and applied to CED-MAIN-001. PDFs: https://invoices.internal/redwood/RV-2028-0616-200.pdf , https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2028-0616-201.pdf

nora_csm: I'll notify the customer and confirm the portal shows the credit on their main account. will include a short apology and explanation that this was an internal merge mapping bug.

amir_fin: thanks. root cause ask: can we add a pre-merge validation to preserve original credit/waiver targets? this has been tripping a few merges. cc @li_sales.

li_sales: will open a small ops ticket to update the merge script to carry forward explicit credit targets and to surface mismatches before merge completion.

sophie_finance: good. document the change and attach to the credit memos for audit. closing loop once CS confirms customer acknowledged.

tom_billing: done - ticket BILL-1492 created and assigned to eng-billing. attaching link in account notes. closing this thread.
